edit.description: hermeticEnv() also strips FLUME_TIP_CLAIM_HELD, joining the other canonicalized FLUME_* vars it already deletes.

summary: hermeticEnv() leaves FLUME_TIP_CLAIM_HELD unstripped; a bare-tick child inherits it from a live ambient flume loop and silently skips claim acquire/refuse.

per.section: The loop lock and the tip claim

tests: tests/tip-claim.integration.test.ts's 'acquires and releases a claim' and 'refuses exit 1 when a live process already holds the claim' pass with FLUME_TIP_CLAIM_HELD set in the ambient environment
acceptance: hermeticEnv() strips FLUME_TIP_CLAIM_HELD; both named tests in tests/tip-claim.integration.test.ts pass deterministically regardless of ambient FLUME_TIP_CLAIM_HELD.
notes: Measured this tick: with FLUME_TIP_CLAIM_HELD ambient-set (this session runs inside a live flume loop, which leaks it to vitests env), a bare tick trusts a nonexistent supervisor and both named tests fail 100%; unset, both pass 100%. e34c41e misattributed this to test-timing flakiness -- it is a deterministic hermeticEnv() gap, not a race.
